zh.text: 貨幣功能

en.text: Which of the following statements is

zh.text: 下列哪一項陳述是不正確的？

en.text: A credit card is money because it is a means of payment.

zh.text: 信用卡是貨幣，因為它是一種支付工具。

en.text: The use of money eliminates the need for the double coincidence of wants in transactions.

zh.text: 貨幣的使用免除了交易中對雙向需求偶合的需要。

en.text: Money performs less satisfactorily as a store of value when inflation is serious.

zh.text: 當通貨膨脹嚴重時，貨幣發揮價值儲藏的功能較不理想。

en.text: In a barter economy, when a person buys a good, he must be also selling another good.

zh.text: 在以物易物經濟中，當一個人購買某物品時，他亦必定正在出售另一種物品。
香港中學會考 1990 卷二 第 58 題

en.text: A time deposit fulfils the function of money as a

zh.text: 定期存款有以下的貨幣功能：
交易媒介
價值儲藏
記帳單位
延期付款標準
香港中學會考 1992 卷二 第 33 題

en.text: Which of the following about money is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪一項關於貨幣的描述是正確的？
它必須具有內在價值。

en.text: It must be backed up by law to be the medium of exchange.

zh.text: 它必須由法律確定為交易媒介。

en.text: It must be convertible into some precious metal.

zh.text: 它必須能兌換成某些貴重金屬。

en.text: It must be generally acceptable as the medium of exchange.

zh.text: 它必須被普遍接受為交易媒介。
香港中學會考 1995 卷二 第 38 題

en.text: In Hong Kong, drivers can buy tickets from tunnel companies for using tunnel services. These tickets is NOT a standard of deferred payment. In other words,

zh.text: 在香港，駕駛人士可向隧道公司購買隧道券來使用隧道。這些隧道券並非延期支付的標準。換句話說，

en.text: the purchasing power stored in the tickets can only be used for certain tunnel services.

zh.text: 儲存在隧道券的購買力只可以在某些隧道使用。

en.text: most people in Hong Kong do not use the tickets for the tunnel services.

zh.text: 大部分香港人不使用隧道券。

en.text: the value of most goods and services are not measured in terms of the tickets.

zh.text: 大部分貨品和服務的價值都不是用隧道券來量度的。

en.text: payment in the future in general is not denominated in the tickets.

zh.text: 未來的付款一般都不是以隧道券作爲付款單位。
香港中學會考 2001 卷二 第 48 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about money are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪幾項對貨幣的描述是正確的？

en.text: The purchasing power of money will remain unchanged in times of deflation.

zh.text: 在通縮時期，貨幣的購買力仍會維持不變。

en.text: A wider use of electronic money will reduce the cash held by the public.

zh.text: 當電子貨幣更普及時，市民持有的現金會減少。

en.text: Money helps people to accumulate their purchasing power.

zh.text: 貨幣有助於人民累積購買力。
香港中學會考 2002 卷二 第 34 題

en.text: A time deposit is better than a demand deposit in serving the ________ function of money because the former ________.

zh.text: 定期存款比往來存款更能發揮貨幣的 ________ 功能，因爲前者 ________。

en.text: unit of account ... has a common unit

zh.text: 計算單位 ... 有一個共同單位

en.text: store of value ... bears interest income

zh.text: 價值儲藏 ... 有利息收入

en.text: medium of exchange ... is generally acceptable

zh.text: 交易媒介 ... 爲人普遍接受

en.text: standard of deferred payments ... is a liquid asset

zh.text: 延期支付標準 ... 是一項流動資產
香港中學會考 2004 卷二 第 36 題

en.text: Money is superior to other financial assets because it is

zh.text: 貨幣優於其他金融資產，是因為它
流動性較高。

en.text: widely accepted as a medium of exchange.

zh.text: 被廣泛接受為交易媒介。
價值普遍較穩定。
以上皆是。
香港高級程度會考 2004 卷二 第 22 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about money are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項對貨幣的描述是正確的？

en.text: Under the electronic payment system, transactions are still settled with money.

zh.text: 在電子化付款系統裏，交易仍然是以貨幣來完成的。

en.text: Deflation reduces the purchasing power of money.

zh.text: 通貨收縮減低貨幣購買力。

en.text: With the use of money in exchange, there is no need to have double coincidence of wants.

zh.text: 在交易中使用貨幣，「雙向需求偶合」便不再需要了。
香港中學會考 2006 卷二 第 33 題

en.text: During inflation, people are less willing to keep their wealth in the form of money. This is because at that time the function of money to serve as a ______ is weakened.

zh.text: 通脹期間，人們較不願意以持有現金的方式來儲存財富。這是因爲在那時貨幣的 ________ 功能減弱了。
交易媒介
價值儲藏
記帳單位
付款工具
香港中學會考 2007 卷二 第 35 題

en.text: A more popular use of electronic money can bring about the following advantages:

zh.text: 電子貨幣更趨普及可帶來哪些好處？

en.text: a smaller amount of coins and notes to be handled

zh.text: 減少需要處理的硬幣和紙幣的數量。

en.text: a lower chance of receiving fake banknotes

zh.text: 減少收到偽鈔的機會。

en.text: more interest earned by keeping the money in banks for a longer period of time

zh.text: 該筆金錢可存入銀行一段較長的時間以賺取更多利息。
香港中學會考 2008 卷二 第 36 題

en.text: When the price of a good is quoted in Renminbi (RMB) on a price tag in some shops in Hong Kong, RMB is performing as

zh.text: 當香港部分商店將出售貨品的價格在價錢牌上以人民幣標示時，人民幣正在發揮 ________ 的功能。
法定貨幣
價值儲藏
記帳單位
延期支付標準
香港中學會考 2009 卷二 第 36 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about money are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項對貨幣的描述是正確的？

en.text: The use of money reduces the information cost of searching for trading partners.

zh.text: 貨幣的使用可降低尋找交易夥伴的訊息費用。

en.text: Money would not exist if there are no banks.

zh.text: 沒有銀行，貨幣便不會存在。

en.text: Money still exists if all transactions are settled by electronic transfer (or settled online).

zh.text: 即使全部交易都以電子轉帳 (或在互聯網上) 完成，貨幣仍會存在。
香港中學會考 2010 卷二 第 34 題

en.text: During hyper-inflation, money would perform the function of a ________ poorly because

zh.text: 在惡性通貨膨脹期間，貨幣發揮 ________ 的功能表現欠佳，因為

en.text: unit of account ... prices of the goods will not be expressed in terms of money

zh.text: 記帳單位 …… 貨品的價格將不會以貨幣表示

en.text: store of value ... the purchasing power of money drops rapidly

zh.text: 價值儲藏 …… 貨幣購買力迅速下降

en.text: medium of exchange ... market transactions will no longer exist

zh.text: 交易媒介 …… 市場交易將不復存在

en.text: standard of deferred payment ... no one is willing to receive payment later

zh.text: 延期支付的標準 …… 沒有人願意延期收取款項
香港高級程度會考 2010 卷二 第 15 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about money is/are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項／哪些關於貨幣的陳述是正確的？

en.text: Deflation reduces the purchasing power of money.

zh.text: 通貨緊縮會減低貨幣購買力。

en.text: Money does not exist in a cashless society where all transactions are settled through an electronic payment system.

zh.text: 在所有交易均透過電子支付系統結算的無現金社會中，貨幣並不存在。

en.text: With the use of money in exchange, exchange is possible even when trading parties do not have double coincidence of wants.

zh.text: 透過使用貨幣作為交易媒介，即使交易雙方沒有雙向需求偶合，交易仍可進行。

en.text: All of the above are correct.

zh.text: 以上各項皆正確。
香港中學文憑考試 樣本試卷 卷一 第 27 題

en.text: Refer to the following news extract.

zh.text: 細閱以下新聞撮要。

en.text: Yu’e Bao（餘額寶）is a new online investment fund introduced by Alibaba. Much of the popularity of Yu’e Bao has come from its ability to give customers the convenience of a demand deposit—meaning they can withdraw their funds whenever they like—but with returns well above what a bank could offer. It recently advertised an annualised return of 5.25%, but that level has on occasion risen to above 7% since the fund was set up. By contrast, banks offer 3.3% as interest for a one-year fixed deposit and close to nothing on savings deposits.

zh.text: 餘額寶是阿里巴巴新推出的網上投資基金。餘額寶受歡迎的主要原因是它可向客戶提供像活期存款般的方便，即他們可隨時提取其資金，但它的回報遠高於銀行可提供的利息。餘額寶近日宣傳指其每年回報為 5.25%，但自該基金成立以來，回報水平有時高於 7%。相對而言銀行一年定期存款的利率為 3.3%，儲蓄存款則近乎沒有利息。

en.text: as compared with bank deposits because

zh.text: 與銀行存款相比，餘額寶是較佳的 __________，因為 __________。

en.text: unit of account ... it provides a homogeneous means of payment

zh.text: 記帳單位 ... 它提供同質的付款方法

en.text: unit of account ... it can facilitate people’s buying and selling of goods and services

zh.text: 記帳單位 ... 它能促進人們買賣物品及服務

en.text: store of value ... it allows customers to have higher purchasing power in the future

zh.text: 價值儲存 ... 它令顧客在將來有更高的購買力

en.text: store of value ... the customers can keep their unused funds in Yu’e Bao

zh.text: 價值儲存 ... 顧客可將他們未用的資金存在餘額寶
香港中學文憑考試 2015 卷一 第 35 題
參閱下圖。

en.text: Ken read the above advertisement and bought a new mobile phone by installments. In this payment, which of the following functions did money perform?

zh.text: 阿健看到以上廣告後，就以分期付款的方式購買了新手機。在這次付費中，貨幣發揮了下列哪些功能？
價值儲藏
記帳單位
延後支付標準
香港中學文憑考試 2016 卷一 第 30 題

en.text: Refer to the following hypothetical case.

zh.text: 參考以下的假設個案：

en.text: The currency of Country T, T-Dollar, has depreciated by 40 percent from the beginning of 2018 after the US announced a series of trade sanctions against Country T. As a result, some shops in Country T quoted prices in US Dollar instead of T-Dollar. Shops in black markets refused to accept T-Dollar. Some citizens bought foreign currencies to safeguard their assets.

zh.text: 自2018年初美國公佈一系列針對T國的貿易制裁措施後，T國的貨幣「T元」貶值了 40%，結果，T國的一些店舖以美元而非T元訂價。黑市的店舖拒絕接受T元。一些市民購買外幣以保障他們的資產。

en.text: Which functions of money of the T-Dollar were weakened?

zh.text: T元的哪些貨幣功能被削弱了？
交易媒介
記帳單位
價值儲藏
香港中學文憑考試 2019 卷一 第 30 題

en.text: Refer to the following hypothetical case.

zh.text: 參考以下假設個案。

en.text: Country P experiences a long period of hyperinflation. When workers receive wages in P dollar (the legal tender of Country P), they would quickly use the P dollar to buy gold or convert it into US dollar. Some workers even only accept jobs with wages denominated in US dollar. Lenders generally do not accept repayment of loans in P dollar when lending money.

zh.text: P 國經歷長時間的惡性通脹。當工人收到以 P 元（P 國的法定貨幣）支付的薪金時，他們會趕快地以之購買黃金，或將之兌換成美元。一些工人更只接受以美元計算薪金的工作。放貸者貸款時一般不接受以 P 元歸還欠款。

en.text: Based on the above information, which functions of money of the P dollar were weakened?

zh.text: 根據上述資料，P 元的哪些貨幣功能被削弱了？
交易媒介
價值儲藏
延期支付的標準
香港中學文憑考試 2025 卷一 第 31 題
